manaNeeded: {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand
easyPrerequisites: Lumbering Battlement must be exiled by Faceless Butcher, and Phantom Steed must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Phantom Steed for its mana cost.
When Phantom Steed enters, it exiles Faceless Butcher until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Phantom Steed's ETB.
When Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield, Lumbering Battlement is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Lumbering Battlement enters, it exiles Phantom Steed until Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Lumbering Battlement's ETB.
When Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield, Faceless Butcher is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, it exiles Lumbering Battlement until Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Faceless Butcher's ETB.
When Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield, Phantom Steed is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
